question_text: A hose fills a tank at 30 liters per minute. Another hose fills at 50 liters per minute. What is the ratio of the first hose's rate to the second?

hint_ladder.title: Unahin ang pagsulat ng ratio
hint_ladder.text: Isulat ang rate ng unang hose sa pangalawa bilang 30:50. Ito ang unang hakbang.

hint_ladder.title: Hanapin ang common factor
hint_ladder.text: Ang 30 at 50 ay parehong divisible ng 10. I-divide ang bawat isa sa 10.

hint_ladder.title: Tandaan ang tamang order
hint_ladder.text: Siguraduhing first to second ang ratio, hindi second to first. Ito ang susi para maiwasan ang maling sagot.

A.text: Correct. You wrote the ratio as first to second (30:50), then simplified by dividing both by 10 — clean and direct.

B.text: You might have chosen B because you flipped the order to second : first. Always follow the exact sequence as asked.

C.text: You might have chosen C because you added rates to get total, then gave first:total. The question asks first:second only.

D.text: You might have chosen D because you gave second:total ratio. The question needs first:second, not second:sum.

next_time_rule: For ratio A to B, write A:B, simplify by dividing both by their GCD. Remember the order — first value to second value, not the reverse.
deconstruct_text:
Sa barangay water station, may dalawang hose: una, 30 L/min; pangalawa, 50 L/min. Ratio ng una sa pangalawa? Isulat: 30:50. Hanapin ang GCD (10). Hatiin: 30÷10=3, 50÷10=5. Kaya 3:5. Option A.

Mental Trick: Isipin mo, 'Una sa pangalawa, simplify lang parang pagbabawas ng timbang — hatiin sa pinakamalaking common factor.' Kaya 30/50 nagiging 3/5. O, di ba, parang pagtitipid sa palengke, laging i-simplify para mas malinaw!
